body:
Issue #894: Make the ticket argument uniform across ticket-scoped verbs so coldstart and build-gate accept --ticket <id> as an alias for positional <ticket-id>.
Acceptance Criteria:
1. Add --ticket <id> to packages/coldstart/lib/cli-options.mjs, packages/coldstart/bin/coldstart.mjs, and packages/build-gate/bin/build-gate.mjs.
2. When both positional <ticket-id> and --ticket <id> are supplied and differ, fail closed with an operational usage error naming the conflict (exit 1).
3. Update --help / USAGE in both tools and document in docs/toolkit.md that every ticket-scoped verb accepts --ticket <id>.
4. Add unit and CLI tests in packages/coldstart/test/cli-options.test.mjs, packages/coldstart/test/coldstart.test.mjs, and packages/build-gate/test/cli.test.mjs.
Verify: node --test packages/coldstart/test/cli-options.test.mjs packages/coldstart/test/coldstart.test.mjs packages/build-gate/test/cli.test.mjs
title: cli: accept --ticket <id> in coldstart and build-gate for uniform ticket-scoped arguments (#894)
